lines: I am now in a silent sky
Spitting out a cloud named loneliness
That cloud brings rain and a rainbow appears
Even though I cannot grasp it anyway
I want to repeat my first kiss
Love bites me
It says it will not let go
But the shape of loneliness seems unchanged
Soar upward
Someday beyond the night
Your song shines to the point of being sickening
Kindness has become muddied days
Melancholy feels like a packed train
A cooled warmth
I tossed it recklessly
Even if I believe in love
It will surely disappear, won’t it
Then I do not need it, it is too sad
Even goodbye
Because I cannot say it well
Instead of waving, I tried to hold you
I saw a shooting star, I saw a shooting star
A song of my wishes
Just being by your side was truly happy
Just being by your side, that alone
Love bites me
It says it will not let go
But the shape of loneliness seems unchanged
Soar upward
Someday beyond the night
Your song shines to the point of being sickening
I will not get hurt anymore, I will not hurt anyone anymore
Your song shines
